name: Be a Silly Seal [Hunting Update]
desc:
[Hunting Beta] A whole new Hunting system is here, alongside 2 new seals, new fish, some quality of life fixes, and more!
+ Pick your weapon, whether a good old-fashioned dart shooter, a sharp axe, or a big fish, show the creatures of the deep who's boss!
+ Use the new Skill Tree to choose your path as hunter, with 24 Unique Skills across 2 distinct Skill Trees!
+ Watch out, the fish bite back! Use the dodge key to avoid hostile bubbles, bites and more.
+ Pull weapons with unbelievable Modifiers! Anything can happen
+ A vast new location has opened... Prepare to dive


Fish, Swim, Explore, Play, and Be a Silly Seal in this seally game!

Fish and Explore the sea for treasures to earn Sealcoins
Customize your seal, your way with different styles, shapes, hats, and gears

Like the game and Join the Group for 100 free Sealcoins

x2 Daily Reward Sealcoins for Premium Subscribers

If any seal has lost data please create a ticket!
